description: Implementation of utility functions for e2sm_kpm, including label and scope conversions, ASN.1 label to enum mapping, and comparison operators for UE ID types.

methods.name: e2sm_kpm_label_2_str
methods.description: Converts e2sm_kpm_label_enum to its string representation.

methods.name: e2sm_kpm_scope_2_str
methods.description: Converts e2sm_kpm_metric_level_enum to its string representation.

methods.name: asn1_label_2_enum
methods.description: Maps ASN.1 measurement label structure to corresponding label enum.

methods.name: operator== (asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c)
methods.description: Checks equality of two ue_id_c objects based on type and value.

methods.name: operator!= (asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c)
methods.description: Checks inequality of two ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: operator< (asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c)
methods.description: Defines ordering for ue_id_c objects based on type and value.

methods.name: operator== (asn1::e2sm::ue_id_gnb_du_s)
methods.description: Checks equality of two ue_id_gnb_du_s objects based on gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id.

methods.name: operator< (asn1::e2sm::ue_id_gnb_du_s)
methods.description: Defines ordering for ue_id_gnb_du_s objects based on gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id.
